summary: A tight two-player abstract where you feed cards into two shared mandalas without knowing which colors will end up scoring big or small, then race to grab the right colors once values are revealed. Every play is a bet on future information, and the endgame scramble to seize the correct mandala colors is genuinely tense.
praised: clever hidden-value hook that rewards paying attention
fast but deep for a 20-minute two-player game
elegant, minimal ruleset with a lot of decision space
criticised: theme is pure dressing on an abstract engine
can feel swingy when the wrong colors go valuable late
very dry for players wanting narrative or table talk

interaction.kind: area majority and blocking over shared card pools

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: the winner is decided by who ends up holding the majority of the colors that turn out valuable
